rows.en:
(I mustn't take my eyes off Dr. Yushima.

He knows my secret and is trying to trap me! He's scheming something… I won't let him!)

Well done, Dr. Yushima! Taking advantage of the radar breakdown, our spaceships have finished assembling.

Preparations for the all-out attack are already complete! Go to the command room at once and thoroughly destroy the Ultra Hawk launch system!!

Once the Earth defense forces have lost their fighting power, we will storm the Earth in one go!! Go, Dr. Yushima!
Dr. Yushima! What are you doing here?
Ugh… What do you think you're doing!?
Doctor! You're being used by aliens! Wake up!
S-stop it! Let go of me… Kuh…
H-hey!! Dan!! What on earth do you think you're doing!
Stop it! Dan!! What are you doing!?
Dan!! Dr. Yushima is one of Earth's precious minds!
The doctor is being used by aliens!
Dan!! Stop it!!

Did you see that, everyone… This man even tried to kill me!

Now it's clear, isn't it? This man is the alien! He's the spy!
Furuhashi, Soga! Lock Dan up in a cell!
Come on, you!
Captain, you're wrong! You mustn't believe what this man says! You'll regret it later!
Settle down, Dan!
Furuhashi! The alien is the doctor! Let go of me!!
Geez… This guy's got it bad, huh?

Why won't you believe what I'm saying?

That brain of his may well be world-class, but that's exactly what the aliens set their sights on! Please believe me!!
If you make too much of a fuss, you'll get worse than this!

Thanks to the Alien Vira's invasion, the Far East Base is as good as defenseless…

If Destron seizes the Defense Force base, it can take a big lead over the other organizations…
Lovely Battle Princess… I thank you for your consideration.

With DARK destroyed… the other organizations have lost much of their strength as well.

Heh heh heh… This is the perfect chance to show Destron's power! Come forth! Revived Monster Corps!!
So they came after all… All right, don't let the enemy get near the base facilities!!
Just as we expected, it looks like the enemy has attacked?
The defense base hasn't come under attack yet!
…So it seems, but that's only a matter of time! Let's go! We can't afford to lose the linchpin of our defenses!
Just as we expected, they've attacked!?
The TDF seems to be hanging in there, but…
…it's only a matter of time. Let's go!! [HERO4]!
Damn… We don't stand a chance like this! Can't the Ultra Hawks launch yet?
Repairing the paddock will still take some time!

At a time like this, and Dan's stuck in a cell…

I'm going to go check on him! I still can't believe Dan is an alien spy!
This is MAT… We'll take on guarding the TDF defense base. Leave the enemy fighters to us!
Beetle and others… launch a joint operation with MAT.
Damn! At a time like this, I'm…
Frustrated, are you, Dan?
Dr. Yushima! Why are you here?

Soon, the Earth will belong to us, the Alien Vira.

Even the TDF, with its state-of-the-art equipment, is powerless before the allied forces of the Alien Vira and Naager…

Surrender at once, Dan Moroboshi. Or should I call you Ultraseven?
So you were a fake after all?
Heh heh heh… It's too late to notice now… Our invasion of Earth has already begun.
What!?

This man's role is over. I'll give him back to you…

Now, be shattered together along with this base… Ha ha ha!

…………

Ugh… Where am I? Why am I here?

I'm sure… I was on a transport helicopter heading to TDF Far East Base…

Doctor… You were used in the Alien Vira's conspiracy!

They controlled you at will and tried to destroy this defense base!
I tried to destroy this base?
No… It's not your fault, Doctor! The Alien Vira are the ones to blame!
And you are?

I'm Anne Yuri of the Ultra Garrison!

Dan! Are you all right? Wait, I'll open the cell.
More importantly, Doctor! This defense base is in danger! Please, help us!
Right… That restores power to the paddock. You can sortie any time!

Thank you, Doctor!

Amagi… please sortie in Ultra Hawk 2. I'll support you from the ground!!
Roger. Dan, be careful!
Good work, everyone… We managed to protect the base safely.
Everyone, I'm sorry for all the trouble. It seems I caused a terrible situation.
Please don't let it bother you. It was all the Alien Vira's doing.
Hmm… Still, that Naager or whatever, joining hands even with the Alien Vira…
Installation of the Yushima Diode is already complete. The long-range radar can be used any time.
You've saved us, Dr. Yushima… The long-range radar is indispensable for remote-controlling R1 reliably.
Now peace on Earth can be maintained forever.
And so, the launch test of Super Weapon R1 was carried out. R1 flew into space with a roar, and its progress was monitored in the TDF base's operations room…

R1, 10 seconds until it reaches Planet Gyeron!

……………5, 4, 3… Arriving any moment!!

…Space signal observed!

Success! A huge success, it's a success!! A giant fireball erupted, and Planet Gyeron has been completely shattered!
Chief of Staff!!

Mm… Unbelievable destructive power!

Once R2 is complete, Earth's defense will be perfect!
Incoming message from Space Observation Craft 8! Their radar has caught an object believed to be a fragment of Planet Gyeron!
That's within expectations… No problem.
Mm…
Dan!! Where are you going?
It's time for my space patrol.

Emergency transmission from Space Observation Craft 8!!

……From Planet Gyeron… we're under attack from Planet Gyeron…

It's no use, the transmission's been cut off!!
An attack…!? Is that what they said?
Yes, that's definitely what I heard.
That's absurd! Nothing lives on Planet Gyeron!!
Captain! We've caught a strange object.
What could it be? That's no ordinary spaceship, is it?
Which direction?
